svg.title: Table / DiningSession / customer grants - code baseline 6d83eac

g.text: Table / DiningSession / customer grants - code baseline 6d83eac
ACTIVE -> COMPLETED only after PAID + separate close.
CANCELLED is declared in enum; no cancel endpoint implemented.
Bill request keeps ACTIVE but blocks new Orders.
QR token is Staff-only; neither Staff nor Customer DTO exposes the price snapshot.
start/end: LocalDateTime + SQL TIMESTAMP; mapper labels API timestamps UTC.
billRequestedAt: OffsetDateTime + TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.
SQL ON DELETE CASCADE belongs to the grant FK, not JPA cascade.
Close explicitly deletes grants; expiry is checked on each request.
Parent entities do not declare inverse session/grant collections.
